title: Pasta with Cream Sauce and Poultry, Ready‑to‑Heat

content.title: About
content.content: Pasta with cream sauce and pieces of chicken meat is a ready‑to‑heat meal designed for quick warming in a microwave or on the stove. It contains durum wheat pasta, a smooth cream sauce, and selected chicken breast, seasoned with herbs and spices.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The dish is engineered for convenience: only 3‑5 minutes of heating are required.
The cream sauce is made from dairy and vegetable oils, giving a velvety texture without excess fat.
Chicken used is lean breast meat, a high‑quality source of protein.
Durum wheat pasta retains its shape even after long shelf life.
The product undergoes thermal processing to ensure microbiological safety.

items.title: Protein source
items.content: Chicken provides high‑quality protein essential for tissue repair and maintenance.

items.title: Energy supply
items.content: Carbohydrates from the pasta deliver a quick source of energy, convenient for busy schedules.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D
items.content: The cream sauce contains dairy ingredients that are sources of calcium and vitamin D for bone health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Both pasta and chicken are rich in B1, B2, B3 vitamins, supporting metabolic processes.

items.title: Low trans‑fat content
items.content: Vegetable oils used in the recipe are free of trans fats, making the product more heart‑friendly.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The cream sauce may trigger reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: People monitoring salt intake should consider the product’s sodium level.

items.title: Heat treatment
items.content: Follow the recommended heating times to avoid overheating and loss of flavor.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: After opening, keep the product refrigerated and consume within 2‑3 days.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Remove the pouch from the outer pack, transfer the contents to a microwave‑safe dish or saucepan, add 100‑150 ml of water, cover, and heat for 3‑5 minutes in the microwave (or 5‑7 minutes on the stove, stirring). Mix well before serving.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a dry, cool place at temperatures between 0 °C and +25 °C. Shelf life is indicated on the package. After opening, keep refrigerated.
